response.sql: WITH acct_vol AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS total_volume, COUNT(*) AS num_transactions FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, total_volume, num_transactions, CAST(total_volume AS REAL) / SUM(total_volume) OVER () AS share FROM acct_vol ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The account's region is taken from its own account record (account.district_id joined to district.A3), not from the client's district, as the request specifies. Transactions without a matching account or district are dropped by the inner joins. trans.amount is summed as stored, unsigned, with no sign applied by trans.type, as the request says 'regardless of trans.type'. The share denominator is the sum of volumes over all accounts in the joined set, not just the top 10. CAST to REAL keeps the division from truncating to an integer, and no rounding is applied.
